Choosing a method & word problems选方法与应用题

A picture frame, a path around a garden, a ball in the air — the equation is the easy part once you know which method to grab and which answer to throw away.相框、花园四周的小路、空中的球——只要知道该用哪种方法、该舍掉哪个根，方程本身就不难。

Difficulty难度 ●●●
⏱ 45 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Choosing a method & word problems选方法与应用题
  1. Variable = what is asked; equation from area, Pythagoras or "height = value".设所求为未知数；由面积、勾股定理或「高度 = 某值」列方程。
  2. A frame or path of width x adds 2x to each dimension.宽为 x 的边框或小路，使每个方向的长度都增加 2x。
  3. Solve fully, then reject roots that make no sense (say why); keep both if both fit.先完整解出，再舍去不合理的根（写出理由）；两个都合理就都保留。
x=2a−b±b2−4ac​​
a2+b2=c2

🧗 The hard part难点 · Choosing a method & word problems选方法与应用题

Turning words into one equation把文字变成一个方程

The algebra is easy; choosing the variable and the equation is the real work.代数不难；难在设未知数和列方程。

  1. w = width, length =w+4w = 宽，长 =w+4
  2. Diagonal 20: w2+(w+4)2=400对角线 20：w2+(w+4)2=400
  3. 2w2+8w−384=0⇒(w+16)(w−12)=0
  4. Reject w=−16 (length >0): 12 by 16舍去 w=−16（长度为正）：12 × 16
Try试一试
A rectangle has a diagonal of 20 cm, and its length is 4 cm more than its width. Find its dimensions.一个矩形对角线长 20 cm，长比宽多 4 cm。求长和宽。
Answer答案
12 cm by 16 cm宽 12 cm，长 16 cm

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Choosing a method & word problems选方法与应用题
  • Border of width x: (10+x)(6+x) → (10+2x)(6+2x).宽为 x 的边框：(10+x)(6+x) → 应为 (10+2x)(6+2x)。
  • Ball at a height at t=1 and t=3: giving one → give both (up and down).小球在 t=1 和 t=3 都到某高度：只答一个 → 两个都要（上升和下降）。
🎯
Perfect square → roots; factorable → factor; otherwise or decimals wanted → formula.完全平方 → 开方；能分解 → 分解；否则或要小数 → 公式。

cards.f: Best method for (x−1)2=12?(x−1)2=12 最好用什么方法？
cards.b: Square roots: x=1±23​.直接开平方：x=1±23​。

cards.f: Best method for x2−x−12=0?x2−x−12=0 最好用什么方法？
cards.b: Factor: (x−4)(x+3)=0.分解：(x−4)(x+3)=0。

cards.f: Best method for 3x2−7x+1=0?3x2−7x+1=0 最好用什么方法？
cards.b: Quadratic formula (D=37, not a perfect square).求根公式（D=37，不是完全平方数）。

cards.f: Consecutive odd integers?连续奇数怎么设？
cards.b: n and n+2 (same as even — the parity comes from n).n 和 n+2（和偶数一样，奇偶由 n 决定）。

cards.f: A word problem gives x=−6 for a length. Now what?应用题中长度算出 x=−6，怎么办？
cards.b: Reject it and say why: a length cannot be negative.舍去并写明理由：长度不能为负。

quiz.q: Which method is fastest for (x+5)2=12? Solve it.(x+5)2=12 用哪种方法最快？解出来。
opts: factoring因式分解
square root method开平方法
completing the square配方法
graphing作图法
quiz.hint: The square is already there.平方已经现成了。
quiz.ans: Square root method: x=−5±23​直接开平方：x=−5±23​
quiz.why: x+5=±12​=±23​.x+5=±12​=±23​。

quiz.q: Two consecutive integers have a product of 72. Find them.两个连续整数的积是 72，求这两个数。
quiz.hint: n(n+1)=72
quiz.ans: 8 and 9, or −9 and −88 和 9，或 −9 和 −8
quiz.why: n2+n−72=0⇒(n+9)(n−8)=0.n2+n−72=0⇒(n+9)(n−8)=0。

quiz.q: A rectangle is 5 cm longer than it is wide, and its area is 84 cm². Find its dimensions.一个长方形的长比宽多 5 cm，面积为 84 cm²。求长和宽。
quiz.hint: w(w+5)=84
quiz.ans: 7 cm by 12 cm宽 7 cm，长 12 cm
quiz.why: w2+5w−84=0⇒(w+12)(w−7)=0; w=7.w2+5w−84=0⇒(w+12)(w−7)=0；w=7。

quiz.q: One leg of a right triangle is 7 cm longer than the other. The hypotenuse is 13 cm. Find the legs.直角三角形一条直角边比另一条长 7 cm，斜边 13 cm。求两条直角边。
quiz.hint: x2+(x+7)2=169
quiz.ans: 5 cm and 12 cm5 cm 和 12 cm
quiz.why: 2x2+14x−120=0⇒x2+7x−60=0⇒(x+12)(x−5)=0.2x2+14x−120=0⇒x2+7x−60=0⇒(x+12)(x−5)=0。

quiz.q: A garden 10 m by 6 m has a path of uniform width around it. Garden and path together cover 96 m². How wide is the path?一块 10 m × 6 m 的花园四周有一条等宽的小路，花园加小路共 96 m²。小路多宽？
quiz.hint: (10+2x)(6+2x)=96
quiz.why: 4x2+32x−36=0⇒x2+8x−9=0⇒(x+9)(x−1)=0; x=1.4x2+32x−36=0⇒x2+8x−9=0⇒(x+9)(x−1)=0；x=1。

quiz.q: Use a graph (or graphing calculator) to find the x-intercepts of y=0.5x2−x−3 to the nearest tenth. Confirm algebraically.用图象（或图形计算器）求 y=0.5x2−x−3 的 x 截距，精确到 0.1，再用代数验证。
quiz.hint: Multiply by 2: x2−2x−6=0.乘以 2：x2−2x−6=0。
quiz.ans: x=1±7​≈3.6, −1.6
quiz.why: The graph crosses near 3.6 and −1.6.图象约在 3.6 和 −1.6 处穿过 x 轴。

quiz.q: A diver jumps from a 10 m platform: h(t)=−4.9t2+3t+10. How long until the diver reaches the water? Nearest tenth of a second.跳水运动员从 10 m 跳台起跳：h(t)=−4.9t2+3t+10。多久入水？精确到 0.1 秒。
quiz.hint: Set h=0 and use the formula; reject the negative root.令 h=0 用公式，舍去负根。
quiz.ans: about 1.8 s约 1.8 秒
quiz.why: D=9+196=205; t=−9.8−3±205​​.D=9+196=205；t=−9.8−3±205​​。

quiz.q: Two cyclists leave a junction near Kelowna at the same time, one heading east and one heading north. The eastbound cyclist is 5 km/h faster. After 2 hours they are 50 km apart in a straight line. Find both speeds and explain why a second root is rejected.两名骑行者同时从基洛纳附近的一个路口出发，一个向东、一个向北，向东的比向北的每小时快 5 km。2 小时后两人直线距离 50 km。求两人的速度，并说明为什么要舍去另一个根。
quiz.hint: Let the northbound speed be v. Distances after 2 h are 2v and 2(v+5).设向北速度为 v。2 小时后的距离是 2v 和 2(v+5)。
quiz.ans: Northbound 15 km/h, eastbound 20 km/h. The root v=−20 is rejected because a speed cannot be negative.向北 15 km/h，向东 20 km/h。根 v=−20 要舍去，因为速度不能为负。
quiz.why: (2v)2+(2v+10)2=502⇒8v2+40v+100=2500⇒v2+5v−300=0.(2v)2+(2v+10)2=502⇒8v2+40v+100=2500⇒v2+5v−300=0。
